format_config: format an OmegaConf DictConfig by recursively applying string interpolation using the master config as context
format_config_helper: recursively traverse an OmegaConf DictConfig and format string values using the master config as a template context
replace_config: recursively replace matching keys in an OmegaConf DictConfig with values provided as keyword arguments
review_format_config: review the format_config function to understand how it applies string interpolation across nested OmegaConf DictConfig structures
test_replace_config: test the replace_config function by passing keyword arguments that match keys in a nested OmegaConf DictConfig
